title: Petite Blossom Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
One small flower at the wrist. A five petal blossom of round clear cubic zirconia around a polished gold bead, about 8.5mm across, is set into a fine gold tone cable chain as its centre link. A quiet everyday piece that stacks with any fine chain or tennis line.

STYLING TIP: Stack it beside a fine tennis bracelet.

Details

  • Flower: Five petals, approximately 8.5mm across, set as the centre link
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia around a polished gold bead
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Chain: Fine cable chain, approximately 1.5mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
